about: Checks Lumo can run on a listing, ranked by how much renters want them and whether the hackathon data can prove them. Ideas: verify each against real data before claiming it.

sourceKey.Open: City of Sydney or NSW open data

findings.title: Fair rent vs asking rent
findings.check: Your own model's price for this flat, with and without parking, against what the ad asks.

findings.title: What a car space is worth here
findings.check: Model's with-parking minus without-parking price for this flat.

findings.title: Your commute, at your time
findings.check: Monday 8 am to your uni or work, not leave now.

findings.title: Real weekly cost
findings.check: Rent plus transport plus parking plus likely bills.

findings.title: Last rent paid
findings.check: What this exact flat rented for last time, adjusted for time.

findings.title: Relisted often
findings.check: This flat was advertised many times recently; tenants don't stay.

findings.title: Close to transport check
findings.check: Real walk time to the nearest station, not straight-line distance.

findings.title: Quiet street check
findings.check: Pubs, bars and late venues within 150 m.

findings.title: Same building, cheaper flat
findings.check: Similar flats in this exact building that rented for less in the last year.

findings.title: Rare value check
findings.check: Flags ads that say great value or priced to lease but sit above fair rent.

findings.title: Days on market
findings.check: How long similar flats took to lease; room to negotiate.
